article.title: Where deficiency of assets to pay legacies, specific legacy not to abate with general legacies.
article.content: If there is a deficiency of assets to pay legacies, a specific legacy is not liable to abate with the general legacies.
article.html:
149Where deficiency of assets to pay legacies, specific legacy not to abate with general legacies.

Section 149 · Part VI · Chapter XIV · page 54 of the Act

If there is a deficiency of assets to pay legacies, a specific legacy is not liable to abate with the general legacies.
